fix(app): a Z pick with a Y pick keeps Z on Z in the WCS-from-features law

The (Z, Y) arm of align_roles was a copy of (Y, X): the Z pick's axis
landed in the Y slot and the squared Y pick in X, so a side face picked
as Z with its edge as Y set a WCS lying on its back. Z now stays Z, the
Y pick is squared to it, and X = Y x Z closes the frame.

Pinned by mcp_wcs_features::set_wcs_from_features_lands_on_the_guis_frame_as_one_undo_step.

Refs #937

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(mcp): set_wcs_from_features places the WCS from role-tagged feature picks

The MCP twin of the GUI's "Set WCS from features" (#701): picks are
list_features ids each tagged origin, x, y or z. The tool runs the
GUI's law (pick::align_roles) unchanged, converts the fit exactly as
the GUI's SetWcs does, and executes the existing undoable SetWcsOrigin
- one History step, no frame maths of its own. Bad picks are refused
by the law's own words; a setup that is not the active one is refused
by name. camcraft-mcp skill documents the tool (PROCESS_VERSION 17).

Fixes #937
